name: e2 SAT Editor
tagline: Satellite channel lists editor for Enigma2, Neutrino, dreambox
blurb: e2 SAT Editor is a satellite channel lists editor with tab navigation for Set Top Box: Enigma2, Neutrino, dreambox lists.
description:
e2 SAT Editor is a satellite channel lists editor with tab navigation for Set Top Box: Enigma2, Neutrino, dreambox lists.

With this software you can upload, download and edit channel lists of your Enigma or Neutrino, merge channel lists, convert lists, export and import channels with spreadsheets, edit services, favourites, transponders, service flags, markers and picons, channel logos.

It supports Enigma2, Lamedb 2.4 and Lamedb 2.5 channel lists, Enigma1 (2.3 and 2.2), Neutrino Zapit XML channel lists (api v1, v2, v3, v4).

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
